contexts.text: Here (), and elsewhere, by the devil is never meant any devil as the prince of others, but all the crew of evil Spirits, and evil itself.
Sin in general is taken for the devil.
The only thing that can drive the devil and his crew from the door, is love to the Lord and towards the neighbour.
So, on the other hand, from proprium, through the love of self and of the world, that is, through hatred, Hell constitutes one devil...
The diabolical crew perceive such pleasure in (inflicting these torments)...
(By doing evil and maintaining falsity) he runs upon the diabolical crew (and thus brings punishment upon himself).
Thus the man who does not live in the good of charity... is one of the infernals, and after death also becomes a devil.
What a devil!

Some had taken with them there the idea that the devil is not to be spoken to, but shunned... It was given to say that not only does this not at all injure me, but also that these devils in the other life have been men, who when they lived in the world had passed their life in hatreds, revenges, and adulteries... and that the devil signifies nothing else than such a crew of Hell... Thus it is false... that there has been any devil from the beginning of creation, other than those which have been such men. HH 311. LJ 14. SE 406:end.
He alone, by His own power, conquered evil, that is, the devil and all Hell.
When He conquered the devil and Hell...
Temptations are nothing but combats with the evils in ourselves, thus with the diabolical crew who excite the evils...
Weapons = defence against evils and falsities, that is, against the diabolical crew which induces the temptation...
Still less does he believe that he himself will become a devil...
One devil punishes and torments another.
Such (Gentiles) in the other life are at first hardly treated by some whom they call devils.
It is slavery to be led by the devil.
In proportion as he is in evil and falsity... the diabolical Spirits who are from Hell approach the man.
It is what is Divine that the evil turn into what is diabolical.
At last (the regenerating man) is thrown into temptations and vexations by the diabolical crew...
They can counterfeit Angels of light, when yet within they are devils.

It is according to doctrinal things from the Word that the devil is continually endeavouring to lead man astray, and that he continually breathes evil in; hence when anyone has committed a great crime, it is said that he has suffered himself to be led astray by the devil; and this is true, although few if any believe it... (for) all evil and falsity is from Hell, that is, from the devil; for Hell is the devil.
The trust or confidence which is said to be of faith (may be) such as is possible with diabolical Spirits...
(Idolaters) evoked from Hell some devil whom they worshipped...
In the light (of Heaven) they appear as devils... AC 5057:end. AC 5058:2. AC 6571:end.
The diabolical crew at once take away (whatever flows in from Heaven)...
Hence, as to the external man they appear as Angels, but as to the internal they are devils. AC 6872:2. AC 6914:3. AC 7046.
There is then what is diabolical in their faces.
In the other life they want to be called devils, provided they are allowed to command the Hells, and thus from command, as they believe, to act against the Divine.
Hence it is evident, that when in (proprium), man is a devil under a human form.
At this day there are external obsessions, even by the infernal and diabolical crew.
In the other life, where external bonds are taken away, such are devils...
If there is communication with infernal Societies, the form is ugly and diabolical...
They said that of themselves they are devils.
Spiritual war against falsities and evils, or, what is the same, against the devil, that is, the Hells.
They said that such are their devils...
If they are asked whether the devil could become an Angel of Heaven, they affirm it...
From Hell, that is, from the devil.

The devil () = what is false; and their father = what is evil; for falsity is from evil as a son from a father. The falsity which is of the devil is the falsity of faith; and the evil is the evil of the love of self and the love of the world.
The devil, who is the enemy, and sows the tares () is Hell.
The diabolical crew attack nothing with man but his loves...
Infernal freedom is to be led by the devil...
The prince of the world is the devil, thus all Hell.
To worship the devil from the good of celestial love... and Satan from the truths of faith. Signified.
They call the punishing Spirit the devil. SE 1687.
Hell in the whole complex is what is called the prince of the world, the devil.
Nor in Hell any devil who was created an Angel of light...

Hell in the whole complex is what is called the devil and Satan; that Hell which is at the back, where are they who are called evil Genii, the devil; and that Hell which is in front, where are they who are called evil Spirits, Satan. HH 544.
[Swedenborg footnote 2.] The Hells taken together, or the infernals taken together, are called the devil and Satan. References.
Thus, the universal Hell in one complex relates to one devil, and may also be presented in the effigy of one devil.
He desired to be the devil himself...
That they may afford aid to some new devil to subjugate the others...
In Hell, the love of commanding is the devil.
After the Lord had taken away all power from the devil, that is, from Hell...
The devil, whose power had been the stronger...
The devil, that is, Hell...
Man stands between the Lord and the devil...
What a devil he would be unless he were reformed.
He who is cast down into Hell is called a satan, or a devil.
These two faculties are possessed equally by devils as by Angels; but devils apply them to growing insane and to doing evil.
Many from the diabolical crew (fully understood the arcana of angelic wisdom, almost as the Angels do); but only while they heard them; not when they were thinking by themselves. Explained.
Those diabolical Spirits also said, that they could will and do according to those (arcana); but they would not. Explained.

The reigning love with its concupiscences... is as the devil in Hell; and the thoughts of falsity... are as the crew of the devil... The love of dominion from the love of self in Hell... is called the devil... DLW 424:2.

Those in the former Hell are generically called devils; and such of them as do not act clandestinely, do not refuse their name. Hence it is that the Hells in the composite are called the devil and Satan.
The diabolical Hell as an opposite corresponds to the Celestial Kingdom...
In proportion as anyone shuns evils as diabolical... He who abominates them as so many dusky and fiery devils; for evil and the devil are one; and the falsity of evil and Satan are one...
They conjoin themselves with the devils there... and at last acknowledge the more powerful of the devils as their gods.
Evil affections and the thoughts thence (make) one devil which is Hell.
The devil, by whom is meant Hell in the whole complex...
A devil is such; for he is self-love itself... Another devil like himself he hates...
Consequently, the love of the proprium is the devil.
The love of self is the devil; and concupiscences and their delights are the evils of his kingdom, which is Hell. DP 217:2. DP 250:4.

Man contracts this nature because the devil himself, with whom he has become conjoined, and by whom he is led, is nothing else than the love of dominion from the love of self; and he who is led by the devil, that is, by Hell, is led into all these evils...

Man knows not whether anyone is led by the devil, or by the Lord. He who is led by the devil, performs uses for the sake of himself and the world... They who do not shun evils as sins perform uses from the devil; for evil is the devil.
When (honours and wealth) are curses, they are from the devil. That honours and wealth are given by the devil also, is known; for from this he is called the prince of the world.

I have seen fiery devils, who, while they heard arcana of wisdom, not only understood them, but also spoke them from their rationality; but as soon as they returned to their diabolical love, they did not understand them; but instead of them, contrary things... I have heard them, when in a state of wisdom, laughing at their insanity; and when in a state of insanity, laughing at wisdom.
These are they who are meant by the devils who make themselves Angels of light...

In (man's interiors) there must be either the Lord or the devil; the Lord is there after reformation, and the devil is there before it; in proportion, therefore, as man suffers himself to be reformed, the devil is cast out; but in proportion as he does not suffer himself to be reformed, the devil remains. Who cannot see that the Lord cannot enter so long as the devil is there? And he is there so long as man keeps the door closed...
Whether it is said evil or the devil, it is the same... for the devil is within all evil.
If this had been seen before, the devil, that is, Hell, would have snatched it out of men's hearts.
In its form, Hell is like a monstrous man, whose soul is the love of self and Own intelligence, thus the devil: for there is not any devil who is sole lord there; but the love of self is so called.
As they favour the delights of concupiscences, they are satans and devils; those are called satans who confirm the concupiscences of evil with themselves; and those devils, who live them.
It fights for them against the devil, that is, against the evils of Hell.

Hell is called the devil and Satan; and by the Hell which is called the devil is meant those who are in evils, properly who are in the love of self; and by the Hell which is called Satan are meant those there who are in falsities, properly, who are in the pride of their Own intelligence. The reason these Hells are called the devil and Satan, is that all who are in them are called devils and satans.

The devil shall cast some of you into custody () = that their good of life will be infested by the evils which are Hell... By the devil is meant the Hell where are those who are in evils; and thus, abstractedly, the evils which are there and thence.

Satans are those who have been in falsities and thence in evils; and devils, those who have been in evils and thence falsities. In the light of Heaven, satans appear like corpses, and some black like mummies; and devils appear duskily fiery, and some black like soot. They all appear monstrous in face and body: but in their own light... they appear like men. This is granted them in order that they may consociate together. TCR 281:end.
Under Black, see this reference.

As Heaven is distinguished into two Kingdoms, so is Hell into two kingdoms opposite to them; a Diabolical Kingdom and a Satanic Kingdom. The Diabolical Kingdom consists of those who are in the love of dominion from the love of self, and are thence in folly; for this love is opposite to celestial love, and its folly is opposite to celestial wisdom; whereas the Satanic Kingdom consists of those who are in the love of dominion from the pride of their Own intelligence, and are thence in insanity; for this love is opposite to spiritual love, and its insanity is opposite to spiritual intelligence.
Under Celestial Kingdom, see this reference.
In the Word, both the devil and Satan are mentioned, and by both is meant Hell. They are so named, because all in the one Hell are called devils, and all in the other, satans.
Wherefore, on the part of God, grace endures to eternity... also towards the devil himself.

Called the devil and Satan () = those who cannot but be in the evils and thence in the falsities of their concupiscences; and who, through separation from the Lord, become devils and satans. Explained. AE 740, Illustrated.
The devil has come down to you, having great anger ()... The dragon is here called the devil, because those are meant who, from this heresy, are in evils of life.
Every devil can understand truth when he hears it; but he cannot retain it, because, when the affection of evil returns, it casts out the thought of truth. TCR 388.

This conjunction, with those who are in the love of dominion from the love of self over the holy Divine things of the Lord, and over the Lord, is like conjunction with the devil, who... is this love; and to approach the devil, in order through him to come to God, is detestable. AR 802.
There are many devils in the world...
This love, which is the devil. (Repeated many times.)

He laid hold of that ancient dragon serpent, which is the devil and Satan ()... As they are in evils as to life, they are called the devil; and as they are in falsities as to doctrine, they are called Satan.

The devil that seduceth them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone () = those who were in evils as to life and in falsities as to doctrine... By the devil that seduceth them is meant the dragon...
Those who overcome evils with themselves, that is, the devil. Signified. That to overcome evils with themselves is also to overcome the devil, is because by the devil is meant all evil.
This man becomes a devil and a satan...
Everyone who is in these things is in company with the devils who are in Hell.

I have seen and heard many complete devils, who understood the arcana of angelic wisdom, when they heard and read them, as the Angels themselves do; but the moment they returned to their own love and their consequent pride, they not only understood nothing of them, but also saw things contrary from the light of the confirmation of falsity with them.
[153a]. He said, Unfold this arcanum: How man created in the form of God could be changed into the form of a devil? (Answered by a Platonist.)
A devil seen ascending from Hell. Described.
The earth now opened to the right, and I saw another devil rising up. Described. On seeing him the former devil threw himself on his knees and adored him...
When this devil lived in the world...
Suppose a society composed of mere devils...

I saw a devil rising up with a bright circle round his head... He said, I am Lucifer the son of the morning... There, I am a devil, but here I am an Angel of light... I am able to preach, and I have preached... against defrauders, adulterers, and all infernal loves; nay, I have then called Lucifer a devil... and when in the pulpit I thought no otherwise... But the reason is, that I was then in externals, and these were then separated from my internals... But still I could not change myself, because I have not looked to God above my conceit... In the body I am an Angel, but in the spirit a devil; for in the body I am in understanding, but in the spirit I am in will... He afterwards spoke about his twofold state... more rationally than anyone; but suddenly, when he saw the Angels with me... he became black... and sank down into Hell.
I then asked the Angels, Whence have devils such rationality? They said, It is from the glory of the love of self...

All Hell consists of such... called satans and devils; satans, those who have confirmed themselves for nature, and so denied God; devils, those who have lived criminally, and so have rejected all acknowledgement of God from their hearts. TCR 35:2.

Through the opening, three devils ascended, appearing on fire from the delight of their love. (They tell what their delights are, and that all are permitted to be in their delights provided they do not infest the good, but that they cannot help doing so, because when they see an Angel and feel the Lord's sphere, it is as if they were seized with fury.)

They who are evil from the understanding, dwell in front, and are called satans; but they who are evil from the will, dwell behind, and are called devils. On account of this universal distinction, Satan and the devil are mentioned in the Word. With those evil ones, and also adulterers, who are called satans, the understanding acts as principal; but with those who are called devils, the will acts as principal.
Because they are of the devil and from the devil. BE 117:3. TCR 3. SciaDoc 10.
They open the lower things of their mind for the devil...
So that the universal Hell represents one monstrous devil... TCR 74:5.
They are called satans who have confirmed falsities even to faith; devils, they who have confirmed evils in themselves by life.
Jehovah cannot touch any devil in Hell, nor any devil on earth... except in ultimates...
(Such men) have power over whole phalanxes of devils; who, regarded in their essence, are nothing but evils and falsities.
Devils and satans cast themselves into the deep the moment they scent Divine truth...

Devils and satans have a constant purpose to kill the Lord; and as they cannot do this, they endeavour to kill those who are attached to the Lord... They make every effort to destroy their souls, that is, to destroy faith and charity in them. Described.
All bread in the hand of a devil is poison...
With the evil, the internal man is conjoined with devils in Hell.
When the devil is mentioned, Hell is meant.
The power to understand and will truth is given... also to devils, and is never taken away. (Shown by experiment.) SE 4754, Example(s).
(A devil seen like a leopard who had got among the Angels in the ultimate Heaven; his torture.)

The faculty of elevating the understanding even to the intelligence in which are the Angels, is from creation in... every devil in Hell... The reason they are not in intelligence... is that they do not will good... consequently, they are averse to know and understand truths.
The devil or Hell attacks man...
There are three things opposite to these universals, which are, the devil, evil, and falsity. The devil, by which is meant Hell, is opposite to the Lord...
Falsity, wickedness, and injustice; that is, the devil himself...
He who is over these (Genii) is called the devil.
Their leader, who is the devil...
The worst or deepest evil, namely, the devil...
Such loves are in the devil himself, and in his evil Genii.
Why evil Genii are compared to fires, and the devil himself to a certain fountain of such fires.
As to the devil himself, it is well known that in the beginning he was created good...
Evil Spirits, who, taken together, are also called the devil... WE 1918.
On the extreme wickedness of the devil.
Only his crew are let out, who are thus meant by the devil, as he is called.
That the power of the devil is a mere phantasy...
On the cunning of the devil in perverting truths and goods.
Under Crowd, see this reference, and at SE 617. SE 5925. DMin 4753.
In this state Souls are devils... SE 372.
The curse of the devil... cannot injure (such).
(Such) become devils. SE 4746.
On the cold of those who are from the devil's crew.
That the diabolical crew want to abide in privies, etc.

I replied, that it is granted me to speak with the worst devils, because they cannot harm me... That I might know the nature of their life... Moreover, by conversing with them they themselves can know their quality... Besides, they are rather to be pitied... If I were not to speak to them, or were to speak harshly, their torments would be added to, which would be contrary to mercy and charity; for to will well, even to them, is Christian. Moreover, some of them had been known to me, and I had not believed that they would become infernals. SE 3489.
That such insects signify the more insane devils.
So is it permitted the devil, because of such a nature, to torment men.

When it was granted to speak about certain things written and published by me, concerning the devil, that he was created before the creation of the world, as a couple between heavenly and corporeal things... They could not have been written differently, because the universal Christian world believes no otherwise...
He constantly called the devil...
I called him the worst devil...
There was sent to them the devil of the cloud...
(The punishment of one who had a habit of naming the devil.)
A certain one said he led (Paul)... but he was a certain devil, who supposed he was the very devil that deceived Adam...
On the devil himself. (He cared nothing for hatreds, adulteries, etc., but only to destroy what is good and true.)
This would be to supplicate to the devil...
When any devil appears from Hell, he appears monstrous according to... Described.
(A devil whom I at first thought was an Angel, and who could almost deceive the interior Angels.) SE 4714.
Under Charles XII, see these references. SE 4748. SE 4764. SE 4873.
Under Adultery, see this reference.
That the Lord can be honoured by the worst devils, if Power be promised them. AE 1029:3, Example(s). LJPost 235.
Thus in a dream I was led by devils, and then three devils approached me...
Who had revealed such things to these devils.
Thus they all together made one devil...
He associated himself with the most wicked devils...
They set up some devil, whom they call Christ.
Another devil entered...
They adored the devil, and the devil gave them command...
1.2. They set up a certain devil... whom they called God the Father... There were many such, one after another...
On devils who make themselves Angels of light.
That they were worshippers of the devil was also disclosed. Described. LJPost 112.
On an honest hypocrite, a devil. Described.

The Hell in which are they who are in evils, is called in one word the devil; and the Hell in which are they who are in the falsities of evil, is called in one word Satan. AE 122. AE 740:2. AE 740:4, Illustrated.
The devil () = the extinction of all good.

They who are in that Kingdom of Hell which is opposite to the Celestial Kingdom are called Genii; this kingdom is what is meant by the devil, and consists of devils who are in self-love. AE 740:3. AE 1043:2.
Called the devil and Satan = because interiorly they are in the evils and falsities which are from Hell.
The enemy that sowed them is the devil; = that evil produces these falsities.
By the devil is meant all the evil that is from Hell; and by Satan, all the falsity thence.
(Such) in their spirit do not see the Lord as the God of Heaven and earth, but some of them... some devil, whom they fear because he can do them harm.
The love of adultery... induces the form of Hell, which is the image of the devil; wherefore the man who loves adultery, and is averse to marriage, is a devil in form.
Hence the devil, by whom is meant Hell in the whole complex, is called a murderer from the beginning.

Thus goods and truths from a celestial origin have for their opposites the evils and falsities which are called diabolical; in like manner goods and truths from a spiritual origin have for their opposites the evils and falsities which are called infernal.
These are among the worst, and are called devils; but the rest satans.
Such in Hell are black devils.
There are in the world men Angels and men devils. (A man Angel contrasted with a man devil.)
I have seen devils reduced into such a state, that they spoke truths from understanding and faith, and did goods from will and love. Explained.

On one side was represented the devil with Hell, and on the other the Lord with Heaven; and then it was said, that the devil or Hell dwells in the evils with man... Also, that the Lord through Heaven continually drives away the devil with Hell...
The devil is evil itself.
Into the external man... evil Spirits from Hell are admitted, who are called the devil.
This was witnessed with a certain devil... The Lord's presence was taken away from him, and the devil lay dead, just like a corpse.
Hell is as one devil sitting on a seat twisted out of vipers, fire-serpents, and poisonous worms.
All evil is conceived from the devil as a father, and is born from atheistical faith as a mother... The generations of all evils... are from the marriage of the devil with the profane congregation.
